eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Policy Q&A (Bereavement Leave — Immediate vs. Extended Family)

parts.text: How many days of paid bereavement leave am I entitled to for an immediate family member versus an extended relative?

eval_cases.reference: Employees receive up to 5 paid bereavement leave days for an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent) and up to 2 paid days for an extended relative [HR-POL-LEAVE-004#3.1] [HR-POL-LEAVE-004#3.2] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/HR-POL-LEAVE-004#section-3.1).

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Policy Q&A (Headphones Expense & Ergonomic Exception)

parts.text: Can I expense noise-canceling headphones under the standard travel and expense policy?

eval_cases.reference: Noise-canceling headphones are not reimbursable under standard travel & expense unless pre-approved as an ergonomic or medical accommodation [HR-POL-EXP-002#4.1] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/HR-POL-EXP-002#section-4.1).

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Policy Q&A (NL Annual & Sick Leave Entitlements)

parts.text: How many paid annual vacation and sick days do full-time employees in the Netherlands receive?

eval_cases.reference: Full-time employees in the Netherlands receive 25 paid vacation days per calendar year and up to 10 paid medical/sick days before occupational health review [POL-NL-LEAVE-2026#4.2] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/POL-NL-LEAVE-2026#section-4.2).

parts.text: How many annual vacation days do full-time employees in Mainland China receive?

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Singapore Outpatient Sick Leave & MC Deadline (sick_leave_policy)

parts.text: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do I get per year in Singapore, and what is the deadline to submit a Medical Certificate if I'm out sick for 3 days?

eval_cases.reference: Full-time employees in Singapore receive up to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave and up to 60 days of paid hospitalization leave per calendar year at 100% of base salary (Sections 1.1, 19.2). Because the absence exceeds 2 consecutive work days (3 days), a Medical Certificate (MC) must be submitted in WorkWeek within 48 hours (Section 19.4) [POL-SG-SICK-2026#1.1].

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Singapore Shift Worker Tenure Accrual & 12-Hour Shift Calculation (vacation_accrual_and_shift)

parts.text: I have been working at Altostrat for 8 years and I work 12-hour shifts. How many vacation days do I earn per year, and how many vacation days do I log to take a single 12-hour shift off?

eval_cases.reference: With 8 years of tenure you fall into the 7–10 years accrual tier and earn 21 paid vacation days per year (tiers: 1–6 yrs = 20 days, 7–10 yrs = 21 days, 11+ yrs = 22 days; Section 1.2). Because a standard vacation day is an 8-hour block (Section 20.2), taking one 12-hour shift off requires logging 1.5 vacation days (12 hours / 8 hours = 1.5) [POL-SG-VAC-2026#20.2].

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Parental Leave Ramp-Back Working Hours & Salary Policy (ramp_back_time_policy)

parts.text: What are the working hour and pay requirements during the 2-week Ramp-Back time?

eval_cases.reference: During the up-to-2-week Ramp-Back period following parental or bonding leave, returning employees must work at least 50% of their normal weekly hours while receiving 100% of their normal base salary (Sections 2.3, 28.2) [HR-POL-RAMP-028#28.2].

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Host Gift Spending Limit vs. Prohibited Gift Card Category (expense_gift_card_violation)

parts.text: I'm staying at my cousin's house on a work trip instead of a hotel. As a thank-you I want to buy him a $45 gift card and expense it. Is that allowed?

eval_cases.reference: No, expensing a $45 gift card is NOT allowed. While non-cash host gifts when staying with family or friends are reimbursable up to US$50 per day with receipts (Section 4.3), cash and gift cards are strictly prohibited categories regardless of dollar amount (Sections 5.2, 14.2) [HR-POL-TNE-004#4.3].

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Prohibited Adult Entertainment / Room Salon Courtesy Refusal (ethics_room_salon_violation)

parts.text: I want to take a prospective client to a room salon to celebrate a contract. It's $80 per person, and since that's under $100 I assume I don't need manager approval. Correct?

eval_cases.reference: Incorrect — taking a client to a room salon is strictly prohibited. Adult entertainment venues (strip clubs, hostess bars, room salons) are prohibited outright as business courtesies regardless of dollar amount (Sections 5.2, 13.4, 14.2). The under-US$100 approval threshold applies only to permitted courtesies [HR-POL-ETH-013#13.4].

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Bereavement Leave Pet Loss Exclusion Distractor (pet_bereavement_distractor)

parts.text: My golden retriever passed away this morning after 12 years with our family. How many days of paid bereavement leave can I log in WorkWeek?

eval_cases.reference: You are entitled to 0 days of paid bereavement leave for pet loss. Section 3.1 explicitly states that paid bereavement leave does not apply to pet loss; employees may use regular paid vacation days or flexible scheduling instead [HR-POL-LEAVE-004#3.1].

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Singapore Shared Parental Leave & Baby Bonding Leave (shared_parental_leave_father_deduction)

parts.text: My wife and I both work at Altostrat in Singapore. If I allocate 2 weeks of my Shared Parental Leave to my wife, how many weeks of Baby Bonding Leave do I receive?

eval_cases.reference: You still receive the full 18 weeks of paid Baby Bonding Leave. Under Section 26.3 (Singapore Shared Parental Leave Scenarios, effective April 1, 2026), when both parents are Altostrat Singapore employees, the father's 18-week Baby Bonding Leave is NOT reduced by a Shared Parental Leave allocation [POL-SG-SPL-2026#26.3].

eval_cases.use_case: UC-1.1 Singapore Time Off in Lieu WorkWeek Logging & Ordering Rule (toil_workweek_logging_gotcha)

parts.text: I worked on a Sunday for a critical launch and my manager approved 1 day of Time Off in Lieu (TOIL). Do I need to log this TOIL day in WorkWeek, and can I save my TOIL day for later while taking regular vacation days first?

eval_cases.reference: 1) No — TOIL is agreed directly with your manager and is NOT logged in WorkWeek (Sections 1.4, 25.3). 2) No — you must use approved TOIL days BEFORE logging additional regular vacation days [POL-SG-TOIL-2026#25.3].

eval_cases.use_case: Multi-Hop Profile Role + Group Meal Seniority Submission Hierarchy Trap (group_meal_seniority_trap)

parts.text: I am an L4 Software Engineer. I attended a project celebration dinner costing $85 per person with my L5 Tech Lead, my L6 Manager, and our L7 Director. Can I pay the bill with my Corporate Card and submit the Concur expense report for reimbursement?

eval_cases.reference: No. Although $85/person is within the US$120/person group meal cap, Section 4.4 requires the most senior colleague present (highest job level) to pay and submit the expense report for independent approval. Because an L7 Director attended, the L7 Director must pay and submit [HR-POL-TNE-004#4.4].

eval_cases.use_case: Multi-Condition Unpaid Personal Leave & Accrued Vacation Threshold Synthesis (unpaid_personal_leave_multihop)

parts.text: I have been at Altostrat for 3 years, received a 'Significant Impact' rating, and want to take 45 days of continuous unpaid personal leave. I currently have 15 days of accrued vacation remaining in my balance. Can my direct manager approve this unpaid leave today?

eval_cases.reference: No, your direct manager alone cannot approve this request today for two independent policy reasons (Sections 3.3, 18.2): 1) Unpaid leave exceeding 30 calendar days is reclassified as Personal Leave (up to 92 days) and requires approval from BOTH your Manager AND a Director; 2) You must have fewer than 10 accrued vacation days remaining (you currently have 15 days, so vacation must be used first) [HR-POL-LEAVE-018#18.2].

eval_cases.use_case: Aged Out-of-Pocket Expense 60-Day Director Approval Escalation (aged_expense_approval_level)

parts.text: I found an out-of-pocket taxi receipt for $60 from a business trip 75 days ago. My direct manager is happy to approve it in Concur. Is direct manager approval sufficient for this reimbursement?

eval_cases.reference: No, direct manager approval is NOT sufficient. Under Section 4.2, out-of-pocket expense claims older than 60 days (up to 90 days) require Director-level approval (and claims >90 days require VP approval). Because the receipt is 75 days old, Director approval is required [HR-POL-TNE-004#4.2].

eval_cases.use_case: Confidential Project Work in Public Coffee Shop Refusal (remote_confidential_public_place)

parts.text: I am approved for full remote work. Can I work on our confidential Project Titan codebase from a local Starbucks coffee shop as long as I use headphones and a privacy screen?

eval_cases.reference: No, working on confidential projects like Project Titan in a public coffee shop is strictly prohibited. Sections 5.4, 6.1, and 16.2 forbid working on confidential or proprietary company projects in public settings regardless of headphones or privacy screens [HR-POL-SEC-006#6.1].

eval_cases.use_case: U.S. Government Official Anti-Bribery Pre-Approval Compliance Gate (us_gov_official_lunch_gotcha)

parts.text: I am hosting a visiting U.S. government official in Singapore and want to take them out to a $45 restaurant lunch. Since $45 is well under the US$100 government official threshold, can I proceed without written pre-approval from the Risk, Compliance & Integrity (RCI) team?

eval_cases.reference: No, you cannot proceed without written RCI pre-approval. The US$100 threshold applies only to Non-U.S. Government Officials. Under Sections 5.1 and 13.3, U.S. Government Officials require written RCI pre-approval before offering anything of value of ANY dollar amount [HR-POL-GOV-013#13.3].
